expectedSwift: Projects support manual ordering, missing-path state, and explicit open-in actions.
actualElectron: Project add, remove, select, deduplication, pinning, missing-path gating, and recovery exist without manual ordering or explicit open-in actions.
reason: The first lifecycle slice implemented safe ownership and persistence before secondary workspace commands.

expectedSwift: Agent and role are per tab, reasoning effort is per project, and agent changes restart only that tab.
actualElectron: Model, mode, and per-session effort controls exist. A local Saved Agent can bind per chat, supplies a strict inline profile to new/load, survives restart/resume, and reconnects only affected idle chats after profile changes. Reasoning effort is still per session, and linked TOML role mutation/rollback plus real-CLI profile evidence are absent.
reason: The local Saved Agent runtime profile slice is implemented, while project-level effort and Swift linked-role configuration remain separate unfinished transactions.

expectedSwift: Dashboard provides six current-project groups while History remains a distinct CLI session browser.
actualElectron: Electron now has Swift-priority status/unread, local project/title and bound Saved Agent name/mission search, Agent badges, schema-v5 pinned/settled shelves, a current-project six-group Dashboard with bounded Git and CLI-owned scheduled activity projections, and distinct opaque-token CLI History list/search/ACP-open/native-delete surfaces. Activity controls remain read-only, and no signed-in real-CLI two-session smoke is committed.
reason: The deterministic UI, local Saved Agent search identity, and main-owned capability boundaries are implemented; PAR-014 control actions and real-user CLI evidence remain separate prerequisites.

expectedSwift: Browser and Computer Use settings inject temporary MCP descriptors and apply restart and permission rules.
actualElectron: CLI-owned MCP CRUD and Doctor exist without Browser or Computer Use integration panes.
reason: Persistent CLI MCP management was implemented separately from Swift temporary integrations and macOS permissions.

expectedSwift: Settings support targeted TOML, providers, models, roles, Agents, memory, compatibility, hooks, skills, and plugins.
actualElectron: Application, MCP, update, Swift import, Saved Agents, Privacy, and Memory panes are present. Saved Agents includes a local revisioned roster, recovery/editor/starter actions, and a separate read-only project CLI catalog. Memory includes a staged durable launch policy, bounded capability browser/preview, global remember, session-only native-confirmed deletion, and private display state. Targeted TOML, providers/models, linked role CRUD, compatibility, hooks, skills, and plugins remain absent.
reason: The settings shell plus bounded Saved Agent/catalog and Memory slices are implemented, while the broader secret-bearing and linked-configuration domains remain unfinished.

expectedSwift: Tasks, background activity, workflows, budgets, and session goals have authoritative stores and controls.
actualElectron: Electron now projects bounded, redacted CLI-owned scheduled tasks, observed background activity, workflow budgets and progress, and session goal state across replay, live, and offline lifecycles. The surface is intentionally read-only: no short-lived action tokens or create, cancel, delete, or edit controls are implemented, and no signed-in real-CLI activity smoke is committed.
reason: The CLI remains authoritative and Electron does not recreate its scheduler; safe control capabilities and real-user evidence remain separate prerequisites.

expectedSwift: Transcript content supports the full table, code, Mermaid, LaTeX, sanitation, and inline media matrix.
actualElectron: Sanitized GFM renders without the advanced parser and scoped local media broker.
reason: The first renderer slice established an HTML-disabled Markdown boundary before advanced block types.

expectedSwift: Project views expose branch, worktree, dirty state, diff review, commit, and PR actions.
actualElectron: Dashboard exposes a bounded selected-project branch/worktree/dirty projection through zero-argument IPC; diff summary and patch reads stay main-only, with no checkout, worktree creation, full review, commit, or PR actions.
reason: The reviewed current-project Dashboard projection landed before the broader read UI and mutating Git workflows.

expectedSwift: App and status menus expose complete state routing, finish sound, voice input, and microphone remediation.
actualElectron: Window, Dock, single-instance, basic tray, Settings routing, and quit cleanup exist without voice or full menu state.
reason: The shell slice prioritized deterministic window and process lifecycle before audio and expanded menu commands.

expectedSwift: Target notification behavior includes explicit permission denial handling and packaged dedicated-user evidence.
actualElectron: Lifecycle notification routing is covered without a packaged Notification Center permission smoke.
reason: Deterministic adapter coverage is available while signed-package TCC evidence still requires a dedicated test profile.

actualElectron: Display-only metadata privacy, strict persistence/IPC, full-DOM/input/AX/native-dialog/restart canaries, and 1100x720 light/dark app-reduced-motion baselines are implemented; the exhaustive normal/private overlay matrix and remaining general AX follow-ups are not.
reason: The privacy vertical slice is production-wired and regression-tested while OS-controlled motion, menu keyboard semantics, transcript live-region isolation, and packaged native-picker capture evidence remain pending.
